tenderSchedule.title: Udupi CMC invites detailed proposals the for implementing the Animal Birth Control Programme for Stray dogs as per the Rules
tenderSchedule.description: Udupi CMC invites detailed proposals the for implementing the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme for Stray dogs as per the Rules

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Previous experience with similar works (Only ABC program of dogs accepted) executed in the last five years (Year 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25,2025-26) for any of the Urban Local Bodies.
The Bidders having Animal Welfare Board approved required facilities like operation theaters, post operative care, dog catching van, dog catchers.(Documents should be Updated in the KPPP).
The tenderer should have skilled manpower and certified Doctors to operate the dogs (details should be submitted).
Valid Animal Welfare Board authorized certificate should be produced.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: No Black list certificate for the firm for this perticular bid has to be submitted
